settlement_source: CF Benchmarks real-time index (BRTI/ETHUSD_RTI/SOLUSD_RTI): consolidated-order-book mid of constituent exchanges (Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp, Gemini, LMAX Digital, Bullish, Crypto.com; SOL without Bullish), 200 ms calc, 1-s dissemination, 0.01 USD precision; contract terms CRYPTO.pdf.
settlement_variable: YES iff avg of 60 index values in the minute before close_time >= avg in the minute before open_time. floor_strike == previous market's expiration_value (39/39 chained) and is visible for the whole 15-min life. Rounded to 2 dp (BTC/ETH) / 4 dp (SOL). Which 60 ticks of the 1-s/200-ms feed are sampled is unknown (Kalshi websocket avg_60s_data suggests 1/s).
timezone: ET in rules, UTC in API; 24/7 on :00/:15/:30/:45; open_time = prior close_time.
tie_handling: 'at least' -> equality resolves YES (structural YES edge at zero move).
rounding: 2 dp settlement average (SOL 4 dp); index 0.01 USD.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Trading open through the ENTIRE closing 60-s averaging window; last trades 0.01-3 s before close; settlement_ts - close_time median 5.0 s (min 4.9, max 11.5, n=40); min tick $0.001 sub-penny.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early=true (template, none observed); no data/incomplete -> affected strikes resolve NO (not void); revisions after expiration ignored; Market Outcome Review at Kalshi discretion; settlement ~5 s after close leaves no appeal window.
title_vs_rules_divergences: 'price up in next 15 mins' is really 60-s average vs 60-s average (~14.5 min midpoint to midpoint)
generic contract template times superseded by rules_primary

toxicity_flags: Settlement variable fully observable in real time while trading stays open -> final minute is a pure latency race; resting quotes near 0.5 are picked off
Opening strike known to index streamers before the API field populates
Depth-weighted index movable by thin constituent books during the window
Equal -> YES and rounding create small structural YES edge
At T-60 s the favourite is already 0.999 in ~75% of markets; tradable edge only in markets with |move| < ~15 USD (BTC) where informed flow concentrates
~10x less volume than BTC (median 196k/market): thinner final-minute book; last trade can be 60 s before close
notes: Subagent rules reader 2026-10-27 (deleg_0679578b). Differences across BTC/ETH/SOL: index, constituents (SOL no Bullish), rounding (SOL 4 dp), liquidity. Kalshi websocket publishes the running 60-s average — requires an API key (account); our 4-venue replica approximates it.
